name: Stark Side Studs Backpack in Visetos
description: A portable icon embodying the boundless spirit of the global nomad. Crafted from Visetos canvas and nappa leather, the Stark backpack is renowned for organizing devices, documents, and accessories in an elevated fashion. Pyramid studs frame the silhouette for a brilliant finish.
details: Outer side pockets with studded embellishments
Interior pocket and sleeve for 13" laptop and tablet

name: Aren Sling Bag in Embossed Monogram Leather
description: Imprinted with the artisanal legacy of the House, the small Aren sling bag in nappa leather is distinguished by an embossed iteration of the classic Visetos monogram. The single-strap design embodies a focus on unhindered mobility, making it a sleek yet sophisticated companion when on the go.

name: Aren Sling Bag in Visetos
description: Mobile freedom with a functional focus, the Aren sling bag is set apart by a sleek silhouette enveloped in the signature monogram of the Munich House. Finished with leather details, the modern companion embodies uninhibited travel and boundless movement courtesy of a singular herringbone webbing strap.
details: Interior sleeve for tablet and devices

name: Aren Sling in Visetos
description: An independent alternative to the traditional backpack. Sculpted from signature Visetos and nappa leather, the mini Aren sling bag features a geometric design accompanied by a singular strap for effortless mobility. Utility remains at the forefront of the design through a combination of inner and outer compartments.
details: Interior pocket with Bavarian diamond leather patch

name: Aren Crossbody in Visetos
description: Expanding on a quintessential MCM style, the medium Aren crossbody bag serves as a consummate companion for the modern global nomad. Fashioned from Visetos canvas and nappa leather, the clean-lined design nests devices and documents in a secure yet sophisticated manner on both short excursions and long-haul journeys.

name: Aren Crossbody in Diamond Quilted Leather
description: A mobile companion showcasing the refined leatherwork of MCM, the season’s Aren crossbody bag features a sumptuous nappa leather body quilted with geometric motifs inspired by the Bavarian diamonds. The silhouette is punctuated by the iconic logo brass plate of the House.

name: Aren Nova Tote in Monogram ECONYL®
description: A revolution in design led by the Munich House, the Aren Nova tote in ECONYL® features an avant-garde silhouette punctuated by covert monochromatic tones. Paying homage to heritage while fearlessly progressing forward, the bag is adorned with the signature logo plate as well as a tonal iteration of the classic Visetos monogram.
details: 7.5" to 12.6" handle strap length, Handle drop: 10.6"

name: Aren Nova Tote in ECONYL®
description: Deconstructing a classic design through the art of minimalism, the Aren Nova tote features a monochromatic nylon composition for an advanced aesthetic. House heritage — embodied through the signature logo brass plate — sets off the silhouette.

name: Ottomar Weekender Bag in Visetos
description: A legendary jet-setting companion, transformed into the perfect carry-on. Sculpted from classic Visetos, the small Ottomar Weekender bag arrives partnered with a leather hang tag and leather-covered metal padlock-with-key.
details: Removable leather luggage tag and leather-covered padlock with key
Exterior leather trolley sleeve at back

name: Ottomar Weekender in Diamond Quilted Leather
description: A masterwork in monochrome, the season’s Weekender design in nappa leather features intricate geometric quilting drawn from the Bavarian diamonds. The soft travel companion is finished with the iconic logo brass plate of the House.

name: MCM x We The Best Ottomar Weekender Bag in Visetos
description: A timeless travel companion, remixed with a charm boasting the “We The Best” philosophy — DJ Khaled's passionate approach to life defined by self-confidence and boundless ambition. Meticulously crafted from Visetos monogram canvas, the Ottomar Weekender bag is distinguished by buttery nappa leather details in a blue tone honoring the city of Miami. Artisanal finishes including a leather-covered metal padlock with keys in line with its jet-setting purpose.
details: Detachable “We The Best” charm and leather-covered metal padlock with keys
Interior slip pockets and zip compartment

name: Ottomar Garment Bag in Visetos
description: A world-class wardrobe carriage, this garment bag in signature Visetos canvas features twin zip compartments for synchronized storage. Enriched by cowhide leather details, the monogram companion is further finished with a rear exterior trolley sleeve for attachment to travel luggage.

name: Ottomar Cabin Trolley in Visetos
description: Sculpted from black Visetos canvas, the Ottomar cabin trolley re-envisions the art of luggage making through the modern lens of the Munich House. Accentuated by masterful leatherwork, the monogram silhouette features an exterior laptop pocket as well as a compartmentalized interior for organization of the highest order.
details: Front zip pocket for laptops and devices
Interior zip compartment with diamond logo leather patch

name: Fursten Belt Bag in Monogram Nylon
description: A mobile masterwork in monochrome, the Fursten belt bag in black Italian nylon and leather epitomizes the sleek design ethos of the Munich House. Enveloped in the signature Visetos monogram, the striking silhouette is defined by a trilogy of zipped compartments.
details: Adjustable fabric webbing strap with metal buckle

name: Fursten Belt Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: Imprinted with an upscaled rendition of the classic Visetos monogram, the Fursten belt bag is an artisanal expression of MCM’s hands-free philosophy. A duet of zipped compartments results in organization of the highest order.
details: Adjustable fabric webbing strap with buckle closure

name: Ella Boston Bag in Visetos
description: Born from the Golden Age of Munich, the Ella Boston bag is an elegant homage to travel trunks of that famed period in German history. An accompanying logo-embossed leather charm — modeled after the Bavarian diamonds — further nods to the birthplace of the House.
details: Detachable logo-embossed Bavarian diamond leather charm

name: Ella Boston Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: Imprinted with the maximalist monogram of the House, the small Ella Boston bag in full-grain leather is an artisanal companion born from the Golden Age of Munich. A renowned insignia of our German birthplace, the Bavarian diamond informs the geometric design of the accompanying leather charm.
details: Interior slip pocket with leather patch

name: Diamond Clutch in Visetos Leather Mix
description: Channeling an eternal symbol of Munich, this small clutch bag features a calfskin front flap inspired by the Bavarian diamonds. Sculpted from Visetos canvas, the geometric design is accompanied by a leather chain mix strap for an elegant finish.
details: Interior slip pocket and zip compartment

name: Dessau Drawstring Bag in Visetos
description: Named after a historic center of Bauhaus design, the Dessau drawstring bag melds form and function in a manner honoring the renowned German arts movement. Sculpted from Visetos canvas and leather, the signature bucket silhouette is finished with the iconic logo brass plate of the Munich House. A matching monogram pouch complements the elegant companion.

name: Dessau Drawstring Bag in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: Named after a historic center of Bauhaus design, the Dessau drawstring bag honors the German arts movement with a silhouette that unites form and function in a timeless manner. Imprinted on Italian full-grain leather, a maximalist rendition of the signature Visetos monogram epitomizes the elevated craftsmanship of the Munich House.
details: Interior slip pocket with logo-embossed leather patch

name: Tracy Satchel in Visetos Leather Mix
description: An original matriarch of the MCM family, the Tracy features a design both striking and sophisticated. Secured by the 24k gold-plated Laurel Lock, the classic silhouette is crafted from Visetos canvas with calfskin leather details for a supple finish.

name: Aren Duo Hobo in Maxi Visetos and Calfskin
description: A two-in-one design, melding modularity with exquisite leather craftsmanship. Sculpted from Maxi Visetos canvas and calfskin respectively, this detachable duet of hobo bags can be paired together or worn separately based on one’s needs and setting.
details: Large Maxi Visetos bag: Interior zip compartment
Small calfskin leather bag: Card slot

name: Aren Hobo in Maxi Visetos
description: Infused with a Cinnamon hue, the small Aren hobo bag is enhanced by a maximalist interpretation of the classic Visetos monogram. The House’s Munich origin is referenced through a detachable leather charm inspired by the Bavarian diamonds.

name: Aren Drawstring Backpack in Visetos
description: The House’s classic drawstring bucket design is reborn as a refined backpack in classic cognac. Sculpted from Visetos canvas and leather, the portable silhouette is distinguished by multiple compartments embellished with buckle hardware inspired by the Bavarian diamonds of Munich.
details: Magnetic snap closure with leather drawstring fastening
Front flap pockets with magnetic closure

name: Toni Top-Zip Shopper in Visetos
description: Crafted in signature Visetos coated canvas with a nappa leather trim, the mini Toni shopper features a geometric shape that's both distinctive and thoroughly utilitarian. The top zip closure secures your belongings inside a lush cotton canvas interior, featuring a brilliant print inspired by the street heritage of the Haus.
details: Interior zip pocket and slip pocket

name: New Liz Shopper in Visetos
description: New Liz, new look. Lighter, softer, and made for movement — the redesigned silhouette features extended leather straps for elevated comfort and a D-ring for personal charms. This modern style is accompanied by a removable pouch that doubles as a standalone clutch for an effortless transition from day to evening.

name: Diamond Shoulder Bag in Visetos Leather Mix
description: A renowned symbol of MCM’s German birthplace, the Bavarian diamond features prominently atop this mini black Visetos shoulder bag. Staying true to the Bauhaus design principle of “form follows function”, the timeless motif inspires the contours of the calfskin front flap closure.
details: Detachable chain leather mix shoulder strap
Bavarian diamond front flap with Laurel logo motif
Interior zip compartment and card slots

name: Pina Tambourine Bag in Studded Calfskin
description: Echoing the rhythmic splendor of the '70s and '80s, the Pina tambourine bag in calfskin is embellished with metal logo stud hardware and leather tassels for an opulent touch. Wear it as a classic crossbody style with the accompanying leather strap, or utilize the rear leather loops to transform it into a belt bag.

name: Aren Vanity Case in Visetos Leather Mix
description: An artisanal abode for beauty essentials, this vanity case in Visetos canvas is crowned with supple nappa leather in a showcase of classic MCM craftsmanship. Accompanied by a leather crossbody strap, the accessory honors the German heritage of the House through a leather logo charm modeled after the Bavarian diamonds.
details: Removable Bavarian diamond logo leather charm

name: Aren Vanity Case in Maxi Monogram Leather
description: Imprinted with the classic codes of the Munich House, this vanity case in full-grain Italian leather features an embossed rendition of the signature Visetos monogram. The mini accessory is complemented by a leather charm modeled after the Bavarian diamonds.
details: Removable logo-embossed Bavarian diamond leather charm
